'''The Scrap Heap''' was the name given to an area of the [[Off-Worlders' Quarter]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ropagi II]]. [[Droid/Legends|Droids]] congregated in the area while their owners drank in the [[Cantina|bars]] and [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] of [[the River]].<ref name="Ropagi II" />
